feature: The cut's panel names the clips the timeline shows
summary: Click a cut you made inside one recording and Edit point now reads Out: Sample Talk and In: Sample Talk, the name both bars carry, instead of Piece 1 and Piece 2, which no bar shows. A cut between two clips still names each clip.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: Scripts/playtest/cut-panel-names-the-clip-walk.json.

try.do: Open a screen recording (File > Open, or the Sample Talk sample).
Press B and click the recording's bar at about two seconds.
Press V and click the cut you just made.
Read Edit point at the top of the panel: Out and In both name the recording, the same name as the two bars under it.
Do the same on a recording with a long file name: both fields stay on one line and give way in the middle.
Drop a second clip right after the first and click the cut between them: Out names the first clip, In names the second.

evaluate: Does Out and In reading the same name, the clip's, tell you enough at a cut inside one recording, with Out and In saying which side is which?
On a long name, is 'Quar...l take' still enough to match the field to its bar?
Does Sample Talk now read whole in both boxes at the panel's usual width?
rough: Matches the mock's Edit point section (video-transition-wt.html, #propsCut): two boxes, Out and In, each naming a clip, with the mock's 6 point gap between a box's label and its value. That gap was 16 before this task and cut Sample Talk short in the Out box.
A long name gives way in the middle in a box about 70 points wide, so very different long names that share a start and an end would read alike. The bar above shows the whole name.
